choices.why: No green velvet sofa is offered, so this dark rolled-arm three-seater with turned black legs is the closest to the rich, dark classic sofa requested and echoes the black fireplace.
A pair of nailhead wingback chairs facing each other gives the most elegant, traditional look, and their cream linen brightens the scheme against the dark sofa.
This large 292x231 cm medallion rug has a traditional design whose charcoal and cream tones tie together the sofa, chairs and pale walls, and it is big enough to anchor the whole seating group.
A dark espresso-wood coffee table with a classic X-base and a 120 cm length that suits the sofa well.
A large 102 cm-wide framed mirror with a soft gold, geometric-classic frame that fills the chimney breast above the black mantel elegantly.
A turned-column floor lamp with a linen drum shade suits the traditional mood better than the modern metal options.

answer.why: Dark seating and dark wood echo the black marble fireplace, while the cream wingbacks, gold mirror and linen lamp shade lighten the scheme against the pale green-blue walls. The charcoal and cream medallion rug unites everything in a classic, elegant layout centered on the fireplace.
